mapper.select: select area_name from sc_store_area where is_delete=0 and biz_org_code =#{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and area_code=#{storeArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select is_independent_accounting from csr_client_wholesale_config where client_code = #{clientCode} and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select ssi.erp_store_code from sc_store_info ssi where ssi.store_property = #{storeProperty} and ssi.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and ssi.is_delete = 0 and exists ( select store_code from opt_app_user oau where oau.store_code = ssi.erp_store_code and oau.biz_org_code = ssi.biz_org_code and oau.is_enable = 1 and oau.is_delete = 0 )
select is_can_edit_price from csr_client_wholesale_config where client_code = #{clientCode} and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select id, client_code, client_name, client_type, client_address, client_id_number, contact_person, contact_phone, email, financial_code, is_delete, is_enable, distribution_way, org_code, biz_org_code from csr_client_info where client_code = #{clientCode} and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and is_delete = 0 and is_enable = 0 limit 1
